policy.redistribution: No binary, firmware, kext, header or Apple source file of the components below is copied into this repository. They are behavioural references only; every artifact that reaches a guest is provisioned by the firmware task and carries its own digest in the provenance bundle.
policy.verification: A component switches to the provenance "provisioned" only when its exact upstream revision and the SHA256 of the acquired artifact are written here. Until then the component stays a reference and the clean-room gate stays open.

components.role: Behavioural reference for the resource manager and the GSP firmware of the GB206 board
components.note: Only the public interface description is read. The matching RM release and GSP version are pinned and hashed by the firmware provenance bundle before they reach a guest.

components.role: Behavioural reference for the Vulkan and the AIR translation layers
components.note: The AIR verifier and the lowering rules are reimplemented from the public format description; no Mesa source is copied.

components.role: Toolchain reference for the SPIR-V target of the translator
components.note: The builder uses the toolchain of the macOS builder; the produced binaries never enter this repository.

components.role: Behavioural reference for the IOKit personalities, the IOSurface and the power contracts
components.note: The load probes record the class selectors, the structure layouts and the build identity of every supported macOS release instead of shipping any Apple header.

components.role: Behavioural reference for the IOAccelerator and the AGDC policy of the guest
components.note: The identity of the GPU is derived from the measurements of the board; the PCI identities of a commercial card are never impersonated.

components.role: Host side reference for the shared backend and its runtime contract
components.note: The runtime is installed on the host by the operator; macxvm only records its version and the hash of the binary it spawns.

components.role: Boot loader used by the per virtual machine images
components.note: The images are built on the macOS builder and copied into the virtual machine; the shared assets of the repository stay read only.

components.role: Behavioural reference for the host ownership of the PCI function
components.note: The kernel interface is used through its documentation; no kernel source is copied and no kernel change is made by macxvm.
